subcategory_text: Systems/products/services that support organizational priorities are identified and key requirements communicated.
informative_references: Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.AM-01 (devices inventoried) and GV.OC-03 (laws and regulations understood)
implementation_examples: Identify the systems/products/services that support each organisational priority and communicate the key requirements (SLA, security baseline, privacy baseline) to the responsible owner teams
Map priority-supporting systems to their privacy-risk profile so that under-protection of a critical system is visible
Review alignment when organisational priorities or vendor systems change
assessment_objectives: Determine whether systems/products/services supporting organisational priorities are identified
Determine whether key requirements are communicated to responsible owner teams
Determine whether privacy-risk profiles are mapped to priority-supporting systems
Determine whether alignment is reviewed on priority or vendor change
